name: project-colors
description: Assign a distinct color to each project and color-code its subtasks (sessions) in a dashboard panel, markdown overviews, and chat summaries.

description_i18n.en: Assign a distinct color to each project and color-code its subtasks (sessions) in a dashboard panel, markdown overviews, and chat summaries.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 为每个项目分配专属颜色，并在仪表盘、Markdown 概览和会话摘要中以颜色区分各项目及其子任务。
